issues.title: Phase 1 — Produce project specification
issues.body:
Create and review the first complete draft of `specification/specs.md`.

## Prerequisites
- [ ] In this repo's **Settings → Pages → Source**, select **GitHub Actions** (required later, for the Phase 2 mockup deployment). This can't be automated by this bootstrap workflow — the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` doesn't have the repo-admin rights needed to enable Pages.
- [ ] Open [`AGENTS.md`]({{repo_blob}}AGENTS.md) — the `title`/`description` front-matter fields are auto-filled from this repository's name/description, review and adjust them if needed, then fill in the **Project Overview** and **Constraints** sections

## Steps
- [ ] Dump your raw notes, brain dump, or existing docs into [`specification/scratch.md`]({{repo_blob}}specification/scratch.md) (or point the agent at any file/pasted text)
- [ ] Ask the agent to run the `import-specs` skill to produce the first draft of [`specification/specs.md`]({{repo_blob}}specification/specs.md)
- [ ] Ask the agent to run the `refine-specs` skill and iterate until the spec is complete and unambiguous
- [ ] Tell the agent the spec is ready to prototype

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Project summary, actors, user stories, screens, acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, out-of-scope, and open questions are filled
- [ ] Human explicitly confirms specs are ready to prototype

## References
- AGENTS.md (Phase 1)
- README.md (Phase 1)

issues.title: Phase 2 — Generate and validate clickable mockup
issues.body:
Generate a self-contained clickable prototype under `mockup/` from the approved specification.

## Steps
- [ ] Ask the agent to run the `generate-mockup` skill to produce the prototype in [`mockup/`]({{repo_blob}}mockup/)
- [ ] Push to `main` and check the live prototype at `https://<org-or-user>.github.io/<repo-name>/` (auto-deployed by `.github/workflows/deploy-mockup.yml`)
- [ ] Review the mockup, then either ask the agent to iterate on it, or ask the agent to run the `sync-specs-from-mockup` skill to update the spec and return to Phase 1
- [ ] Tell the agent the mockup is approved

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Mockup is generated and navigable
- [ ] Human reviews the mockup and either approves or requests another iteration

## References
- AGENTS.md (Phase 2)
- README.md (Phase 2)

issues.title: Phase 3 — Create implementation, deployment, and monitoring plans
issues.body:
Create actionable plans and track each action item via GitHub issues.

## Steps
- [ ] Ask the agent to run the `create-plan` skill
- [ ] Review [`plan/implementation.md`]({{repo_blob}}plan/implementation.md), [`plan/deployment.md`]({{repo_blob}}plan/deployment.md), and [`plan/monitoring.md`]({{repo_blob}}plan/monitoring.md)
- [ ] Review and reprioritize the GitHub issues the agent created from the plan's action items

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `plan/implementation.md`, `plan/deployment.md`, and `plan/monitoring.md` are created and reviewed
- [ ] Action items are represented as GitHub issues with clear acceptance criteria

## References
- AGENTS.md (Phase 3)
- README.md (Phase 3)

issues.title: Phase 4 — Execute planned issues to deliver first QA/staging release
issues.body:
Implement prioritized plan issues and merge reviewed pull requests until the first version runs in QA/staging.

## Steps
- [ ] For each planned issue, set the **AI Coding Agent** label (`agent:claude` or `agent:copilot`)
- [ ] For `agent:claude` issues: open a Claude Code session, reference the issue, implement on a branch, and open a PR
- [ ] For `agent:copilot` issues: assign to `@copilot` or click **"Request Copilot"**
- [ ] Review and merge the resulting pull requests, tracking progress in [`implementation/progress.md`]({{repo_blob}}implementation/progress.md)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Planned scope is implemented through issue-driven PRs
- [ ] First version is deployed to QA/staging
- [ ] Progress is tracked in `implementation/progress.md`

## References
- AGENTS.md (Phase 4)
- README.md (Phase 4)

issues.title: Phase 5 — Enable ongoing operate loop with issue templates
issues.body:
Set up issue templates and labels so users can continuously submit bug reports and feature requests.

## Steps
- [ ] Ask the agent to run the `issue-template-maker` skill
- [ ] Confirm the templates are live under [`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`]({{repo_blob}}.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) and the `agent:claude` / `agent:copilot` labels exist
- [ ] Start routing incoming feature requests and bug reports to Claude or Copilot as they arrive

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Issue templates are project-aware
- [ ] Agent routing labels are available and used (`agent:claude`, `agent:copilot`)
- [ ] Team is ready to process incoming issues continuously

## References
- AGENTS.md (Phase 5)
- README.md (Phase 5)
